Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

  • Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues
  • Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops
  • Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis
  • Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets
  • Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues
  • Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

  • Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing
  • Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)
  • Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management
  • Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)
  • Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting
  • Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

  • Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)
  • Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration
  • Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

  • Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances
  • Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring
  • Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage
  • Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

  • Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build
  • Contribute to architecture decisions within your workstream; evaluate native Connect capability before custom builds (“configuration over customization”), surface trade-offs to practice leads, and document decisions
  • Perform code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level CX engineers through pairing and review feedback
  • Contribute reusable assets back to the practice, shared CDK constructs, skills/plugins, demo environments, and internal tooling, so the next engagement starts further ahead
  • Support pre-sales when needed: build proof-of-concept demos and provide implementation-grounded input on estimates and SOW technical scope

Your Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building on Amazon Connect or comparable CCaaS platforms at enterprise scale
  • Strong, current Amazon Connect skills: contact flows, routing, Cases and Tasks, Contact Lens, Customer Profiles, Streams API, and the Connect data/analytics stack
  • Hands-on experience with conversational and generative AI, Amazon Lex plus LLM- based development (Amazon Bedrock, Q in Connect, or equivalent), including prompt engineering and tool calling
  • Strong TypeScript/Node.js and Python; production React experience; solid AWS serverless engineering (Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Kinesis)
  • Infrastructure as code proficiency with AWS CDK or Terraform, including multi- account deployment patterns
  • Experience shipping and supporting production systems, testing discipline, observability instrumentation, and incident debugging across the full stack
  • Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)
  • Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)
  • Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector (Section 508, FedRAMP), healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services
  • Contact center operations fluency: WFM concepts (forecasting, scheduling, adherence), quality management, outbound compliance (TCPA), and CX KPIs (containment, AHT, CSAT, SLA/TAT)
  • Experience with AI observability (trace correlation, token/cost attribution, latency profiling) or accessibility engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA, axe-core automation)
  • Consulting or client-delivery background

Benefits

  • 100% remote work
  • Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications

  • State of the art laptop and tools

About XBOW

Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks.

Founded by Oege de Moor, creator of GitHub Copilot, and backed by Sequoia, Altimeter, and other leading investors, XBOW is applying cutting-edge AI to one of the world’s most urgent problems. In just over a year, our AI, built by a world-class AI team and legendary security researchers — has uncovered thousands of real-world zero-days across the software billions rely on, and achieved the #1 ranking on HackerOne’s global leaderboard.

We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who’s passionate about building reliable and high quality products with robust backend systems. In this role, you’ll design and implement end-to-end features across the stack: from React-based frontends and TypeScript APIs to backend services in Kotlin and Go, all deployed on AWS.

You’ll be joining a small team of superstars that’s shipping quickly and operating with high trust. This is a role for someone who loves to own open-ended problems and figure things out—whether that’s designing seamless API contracts, optimizing database interactions, or building scalable systems that make powerful AI capabilities accessible. If you like being at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact, you’ll feel right at home.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build full-stack systems that integrate frontend and backend seamlessly

  • Develop scalable APIs and backend services in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Go

  • Deploy and operate services in AWS and other cloud providers

  • Own problems end-to-end—from design through deployment to production support

  • Navigate ambiguity and help define how we build as much as what we build

  • Collaborate closely with teammates across the stack, including AI researchers, Security researchers and backend engineers

Who You Are

  • Experience building and operating full-stack systems

  • Proficiency with TypeScript

  • Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST or GraphQL)

  • Strong backend development experience (Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or similar languages)

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with incomplete information

  • A thoughtful communicator who values clarity and simplicity

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or async workflows

  • Experience building scrappy, iterative frontends where speed and feedback loops matter more than polish

  • Familiarity with AWS or similar cloud platforms

  • Comfort working with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform or CDK)

  • A strong appreciation for user experience and design, even if you’re not a formal designer — you care about how features feel as much as how they work

  • Comfortable prototyping quickly in React/TypeScript and turning ideas into working features fast

  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases (we use Postgres), and you know how to structure data for both performance and clarity.

  • Background in systems programming, networking, or performance tuning

  • Experience with hybrid deployments (cloud + on-prem) and know how to build resilient systems that handle the complexity of mixed environments.

  • Experience working in an early stage startup

  • Prior experience building security products or products for technical users

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary and a generous equity package, making you a true owner of the company.

  • Career Growth: Shape your role, lead the function, and grow with the company as we redefine cybersecurity.

  • Meaningful Work: You will tackle technically complex challenges and play a pivotal role in the growth of our business, working alongside an amazing team and some of the world’s experts to shape how AI transforms cybersecurity.

What Else You Should Know

  • Location: Remote (all team members are remote but we meet regularly and you’re supported to travel to collaborate with colleagues in person)

  • Contract: Full-time.

  • Hiring Process:

    1. 45-min introductory chat with our Talent team.

    2. 45 minutes with one of our Engineering Leads.

    3. 2-3 hour technical deep dive around relevant case study.

    4. 30-min final meeting with the Engineering Lead for the assigned team..

We aren't focused on seniority titles at XBOW—so if you’re worried about “leveling,” don’t be. We care a lot more about mission fit, capability, and impact than what’s on your LinkedIn headline.

We believe in people who are driven by curiosity and a willingness to learn. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply if you're excited about the role and our mission.

This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable.

Our Core AI Squad:

The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed
  • Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks
  • Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost
  • Evaluate models and providers for specific product use cases, using clear success criteria and abstractions that keep the platform flexible as the AI ecosystem evolves
  • Own evaluation, tracing, observability, and quality feedback loops for AI features so the team can detect regressions, understand behavior, and improve over time
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices, test automation, maintainability, and operational excellence
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, security, and engineering partners to turn ambiguous AI product opportunities into reliable customer-facing features
  • Comfort building, debugging, and operating services that interact with PostgreSQL, SQS, gRPC, and REST APIs, including data models, event streams, service contracts, and versioning
  • Contribute as a senior individual contributor through technical leadership, architecture input, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production systems
  • Strong proficiency with Python in production environments, including APIs, services, tests, debugging, and operational ownership
  • Hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating agentic systems, agent harnesses, tool orchestration, or LLM-powered workflows
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or similar platforms (PydanticAI, CrewAI, etc)
  • Experience with MCP, vector databases, retrieval patterns, RAG architectures, or AI evaluation platforms
  • Comfortable working across a polyglot stack, especially contributing to or integrating with PHP and Java services when the product requires it
  • Familiarity with prompt and version management, guardrails, tracing, LLM observability, cost and latency optimization, or human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, plus experience working with remote-first, globally distributed teams
  • Experience with API-driven design, distributed systems, data modeling, and reliable service boundaries
  • Strong knowledge of software best practices, design patterns, performance, security-minded development, and testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in complex systems with uncertain or probabilistic behavior
  • Good product sense, customer empathy, strong communication, teamwork, ownership, and time management
  • Business-level English fluency, verbal and written

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $140,000 and $180,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. (The salary is only for US-based candidates).

title: Business Systems Engineer
description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 Job Summary As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling. You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org. Key Responsibilities AI-Native Automation & Agent Development Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations. Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows. Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform. Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases. Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team. Business Systems Integration & Architecture Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design. Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines. Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies. Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly. Platform Development & Tooling Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead. Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively. Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented. Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization. Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations. Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches. Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team. Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions. Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution. Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry. Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery. Qualifications Experience 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role. Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred). Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it. Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs. Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems. Skills & Competencies Technical Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required. NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition. Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability. Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus. Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations. Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time). Operational & Mindset Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away. Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there. AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically. ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem. Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability. AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns. Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions. Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.   • Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

Platform Development & Tooling

  • Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

  • Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

  • Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

  • Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

  • Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integration
description: Software Engineer, Data Integration In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives. Who We Are Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you’ll do You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients. Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened. Responsibilities Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes. Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations. Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication. Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort. Minimum qualifications BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience 3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred) Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources. Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results. Preferred qualifications Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR. Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require. Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Quality Platform
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. About the Role: Remote (Toronto or Montreal) As a Senior Engineer on the Quality Platform team, you'll build the shared testing infrastructure, frameworks, and AI-assisted tooling that every engineering team at MaintainX relies on to ship quickly and confidently. Rather than owning testing for a single product area, you'll create the platform, developer experience, and automation that make high-quality software the default across the organization. You'll partner closely with product engineering teams, Quality Advocates, and SRE to improve developer productivity, increase release confidence, and help shape the future of AI-powered testing at MaintainX. What You'll Do: Build and evolve MaintainX's shared quality platform, test automation frameworks, and developer tooling. Design and develop AI-assisted test authoring infrastructure that significantly reduces test creation time while maintaining high quality. Own CI integration standards and improve build reliability across engineering teams. Design test harnesses for AI-powered product capabilities, including health checks, graceful degradation, quota monitoring, and adversarial testing. Identify and eliminate systemic test debt and flaky tests before they impact engineering teams. Build shared testing utilities and frameworks adopted across the engineering organization. Partner with Quality Advocates, product engineering teams, and SRE to continuously improve testing strategy and platform reliability. Evaluate emerging AI testing tools and drive adoption where they create measurable engineering impact. About You: Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience writing, debugging, and maintaining production application code. Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, or similar technologies. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky or failing test suites. Experience building or maintaining shared developer tooling, testing infrastructure, or engineering platforms — comfort with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), containerized environments, and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) is a plus. Experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar to accelerate engineering workflows while applying sound engineering judgment. Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through production support. Experience mentoring engineers and helping raise engineering quality across teams. Strong spoken and written English, as you'll collaborate daily with engineering leaders and managers across multiple teams and present technical priorities to executive stakeholders. Nice to Have: Experience building test harnesses for AI-powered features, including health checks, circuit-breakers, adversarial testing, or resilience testing. Experience building or maintaining autonomous or agentic AI systems. Experience evaluating AI-powered developer tools and integrating them into engineering workflows. Experience building observability and quality metrics into testing platforms. Experience working with large-scale developer platforms supporting multiple engineering teams. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations , and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk .

title: Integrations Engineer
description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: Thailand is one of Cloudbeds’ largest and most important markets, and Thai hoteliers run on an integration stack most of the world never sees. Hundreds of our largest Thai properties depend on these connections every day, and when one breaks, a front desk agent stops being a host and servicing guests. As our Integrations Developer in Thailand, you’ll be the engineer who makes that stack reliable. You’ll work hand in hand with our long-standing local integration partner, MecX Tech, and with Cloudbeds’ Integrations Product and Engineering teams, to diagnose and fix integration issues at the code level, harden the integrations our customers rely on most, and design and build new integrations for the Thai market. This is a hands-on build role with a customer-facing edge. You’ll own the hardest technical escalations, ship the fixes, and then build the tooling, monitoring and documentation that stop the same problem from coming back. You’ll champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission by using AI-assisted development and automation to move fast, so more of your time goes to the problems that genuinely need an engineer. Our Integrations Team Cloudbeds connects to hundreds of partners across payments, accounting, distribution, access control, guest experience and government reporting. Our Integrations Product and Engineering teams design those connections, our partners build on our Open API, and our Customer Success team makes sure hoteliers get the outcome they were promised. You’ll sit at the center of all three for the Thai market, with a direct line into how integrations are prioritized, built and supported across APAC. What You Bring to the Team Own the Thai Integration Stack Technically: Become the engineering subject matter expert on our Thailand integrations, starting with the MecX Tech portfolio: accounting (Carmen, FlowAccount), government guest reporting (TM30 / RR4), local payment gateways, door locks, ID and passport readers, and POS. Fix It at the Source: Investigate integration failures end to end, across Cloudbeds APIs and webhooks, partner services, logs and data, and ship code-level fixes rather than workarounds. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Support and Onboarding on these integrations. Partner Engineering Liaison: Work day-to-day with MecX Tech and other Thai development partners as a technical peer: joint debugging, code and design reviews, shared issue logs, release coordination, and clear technical specs for partner-built work. Harden and Modernize: Help bring the most business-critical integrations onto Cloudbeds-managed infrastructure and source control, with proper deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting, so issues are caught before a hotelier has to report them. Debug and Diagnose: Use your knowledge of C# to debug and diagnose issues within existing integrations, validate fixes with real customers, and build monitoring and tooling to keep things working smoothly. Build Support Tooling: Create the diagnostic tools, runbooks, and dashboards that let Support and Onboarding resolve common integration issues without escalating to you. Close the Loop with Product: Turn recurring field issues into well-evidenced bug reports, API improvement requests and product feedback. Advocate for the Thai market inside Cloudbeds. Document Everything: Keep technical documentation, architecture notes, and knowledge base content current in both English and Thai. What Sets You Up for Success Real Integration Engineering Depth: 4+ years building and supporting production integrations between third-party systems: REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML payloads, data mapping, retries and error handling. Solid Backend Skills: Professional experience with C# and MySQL is a must. Python, JAVA, PHP, JS are a big plus. You must be comfortable reading and debugging code you didn’t write. Production Ownership: Experience with cloud hosting (AWS preferred), Git-based workflows, CI/CD, logging and monitoring. You’ve been on the hook for something that had to keep running. Show Strong AI Smarts: You use AI coding and debugging tools as part of how you work, pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, and look for ways to automate the repetitive. Hospitality: Experience with hotel technology, such as PMS, channel managers, payment gateways, POS, door locks or hotel accounting systems. Understanding night audit, revenue posting and how a hotel closes its day is a major plus. Thai Market Fluency: Native or business-fluent Thai plus strong professional English . You can debug with a Thai partner’s developers in the morning and write a clear technical design for a global engineering team in the afternoon. Works Independently: You are comfortable as the senior technical person in your time zone, set your own priorities, and know when and how to escalate. Clear Communicator: Able to explain technical root causes and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, support agents, and non-technical hotel staff alike. Inclusive Outlook: Comfortable working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds across many time zones. Bonus Skills to Stand Out Direct experience with Carmen Software, FlowAccount, or another hotel back-office or accounting platform. Hands-on experience with TM30 / RR4 or other government guest reporting integrations. Experience integrating Thai or APAC payment gateways (for example, 2C2P, KBank, SCB, KTB, PromptPay). Experience with Windows-hosted services, desktop agents, or on-premises hardware integrations (door locks, ID readers, POS). Prior experience at or with a Thai hospitality technology partner, reseller, or system integrator. Experience with the Cloudbeds Open API or another PMS API. Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. raw.jobDescription:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

Thailand is one of Cloudbeds’ largest and most important markets, and Thai hoteliers run on an integration stack most of the world never sees. Hundreds of our largest Thai properties depend on these connections every day, and when one breaks, a front desk agent stops being a host and servicing guests.

As our Integrations Developer in Thailand, you’ll be the engineer who makes that stack reliable. You’ll work hand in hand with our long-standing local integration partner, MecX Tech, and with Cloudbeds’ Integrations Product and Engineering teams, to diagnose and fix integration issues at the code level, harden the integrations our customers rely on most, and design and build new integrations for the Thai market.

This is a hands-on build role with a customer-facing edge. You’ll own the hardest technical escalations, ship the fixes, and then build the tooling, monitoring and documentation that stop the same problem from coming back. You’ll champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission by using AI-assisted development and automation to move fast, so more of your time goes to the problems that genuinely need an engineer.

Our Integrations Team

Cloudbeds connects to hundreds of partners across payments, accounting, distribution, access control, guest experience and government reporting. Our Integrations Product and Engineering teams design those connections, our partners build on our Open API, and our Customer Success team makes sure hoteliers get the outcome they were promised. You’ll sit at the center of all three for the Thai market, with a direct line into how integrations are prioritized, built and supported across APAC.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Own the Thai Integration Stack Technically: Become the engineering subject matter expert on our Thailand integrations, starting with the MecX Tech portfolio: accounting (Carmen, FlowAccount), government guest reporting (TM30 / RR4), local payment gateways, door locks, ID and passport readers, and POS.
  • Fix It at the Source: Investigate integration failures end to end, across Cloudbeds APIs and webhooks, partner services, logs and data, and ship code-level fixes rather than workarounds. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Support and Onboarding on these integrations.
  • Partner Engineering Liaison: Work day-to-day with MecX Tech and other Thai development partners as a technical peer: joint debugging, code and design reviews, shared issue logs, release coordination, and clear technical specs for partner-built work.
  • Harden and Modernize: Help bring the most business-critical integrations onto Cloudbeds-managed infrastructure and source control, with proper deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting, so issues are caught before a hotelier has to report them.
  • Debug and Diagnose: Use your knowledge of C# to debug and diagnose issues within existing integrations, validate fixes with real customers, and build monitoring and tooling to keep things working smoothly.
  • Build Support Tooling: Create the diagnostic tools, runbooks, and dashboards that let Support and Onboarding resolve common integration issues without escalating to you.
  • Close the Loop with Product: Turn recurring field issues into well-evidenced bug reports, API improvement requests and product feedback. Advocate for the Thai market inside Cloudbeds.
  • Document Everything: Keep technical documentation, architecture notes, and knowledge base content current in both English and Thai.

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Real Integration Engineering Depth: 4+ years building and supporting production integrations between third-party systems: REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML payloads, data mapping, retries and error handling.
  • Solid Backend Skills: Professional experience with C# and MySQL is a must. Python, JAVA, PHP, JS are a big plus. You must be comfortable reading and debugging code you didn’t write.
  • Production Ownership: Experience with cloud hosting (AWS preferred), Git-based workflows, CI/CD, logging and monitoring. You’ve been on the hook for something that had to keep running.
  • Show Strong AI Smarts: You use AI coding and debugging tools as part of how you work, pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, and look for ways to automate the repetitive.
  • Hospitality: Experience with hotel technology, such as PMS, channel managers, payment gateways, POS, door locks or hotel accounting systems. Understanding night audit, revenue posting and how a hotel closes its day is a major plus.
  • Thai Market Fluency: Native or business-fluent Thai plus strong professional English. You can debug with a Thai partner’s developers in the morning and write a clear technical design for a global engineering team in the afternoon.
  • Works Independently: You are comfortable as the senior technical person in your time zone, set your own priorities, and know when and how to escalate.
  • Clear Communicator: Able to explain technical root causes and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, support agents, and non-technical hotel staff alike.
  • Inclusive Outlook: Comfortable working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds across many time zones.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out

  • Direct experience with Carmen Software, FlowAccount, or another hotel back-office or accounting platform.
  • Hands-on experience with TM30 / RR4 or other government guest reporting integrations.
  • Experience integrating Thai or APAC payment gateways (for example, 2C2P, KBank, SCB, KTB, PromptPay).
  • Experience with Windows-hosted services, desktop agents, or on-premises hardware integrations (door locks, ID readers, POS).
  • Prior experience at or with a Thai hospitality technology partner, reseller, or system integrator.
  • Experience with the Cloudbeds Open API or another PMS API.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

description: About Notabene Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack. We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more. We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry! The Impact You'll Have: Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers. You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go. As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work. What You'll Do Design and build core parts of our transaction platform. Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs. Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy. Write design docs for what you build, and give sharp, useful reviews on other people’s designs and code. Build with AI agents every day, and help improve the specs, context and review practices that make agent-written code safe to ship in a regulated product. Work with product, compliance and customer-facing teams to turn regulatory and customer needs into working software. Own what you ship in production, from tracing and alerts to incident follow-ups. Mentor engineers on the team. Work on an on call rotation Must Haves Systems design depth. You’ve designed and owned distributed systems where correctness matters more than features. You know asynchronous processing well and can reason about what happens when parts of it fail. Strong Go, or deep production experience in another statically typed backend language (Java, Kotlin, Rust, C#) and the appetite to be shipping Go within your first weeks. PostgreSQL in depth: schema design, query plans, locking and isolation levels, migrations on live systems, and multi-tenant data. End-to-end ownership in the cloud. Working knowledge of AWS or GCP: IAM, networking, managed databases, queues and storage. You can read and change Terraform and debug production from traces and logs. AI-native engineering. You use coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and can show how. You write the specs and context, break work down for them, and review their output as hard as a human pull request. You know where they fail. Staff-level experience. A track record of delivering large, technically hard projects end to end and helping the engineers around you get better. Typically 8+ years building backend systems. Clear, concise writing in a remote company that makes decisions in documents and async threads. Security fundamentals for sensitive data: encryption in transit and at rest, key handling, minimising personal data, and least-privilege access. Nice-to-Haves Applied cryptography: encryption, signing and key management. Decentralized identity: DIDs, verifiable credentials, DIDComm. Regulated finance, payments or compliance: Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022. Building and running software under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls. Crypto and blockchain knowledge: chains, addresses, assets, CAIP identifiers. Node.js and TypeScript. Queue and workflow systems, and modern observability tooling. Benefits Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record. Apply Today! If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you’re returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar. About Notabene

Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Leading crypto organizations use our tools to reduce transaction risk and make crypto transfers safe. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack.

We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more.

We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Impact You'll Have:

Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers.

You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go.

As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build core parts of our transaction platform.

  • Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs.

  • Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy.

  • Write design docs for what you build, and give sharp, useful reviews on other people’s designs and code.

  • Build with AI agents every day, and help improve the specs, context and review practices that make agent-written code safe to ship in a regulated product.

  • Work with product, compliance and customer-facing teams to turn regulatory and customer needs into working software.

  • Own what you ship in production, from tracing and alerts to incident follow-ups.

  • Mentor engineers on the team.

  • Work on an on call rotation

Must Haves

  • Systems design depth. You’ve designed and owned distributed systems where correctness matters more than features. You know asynchronous processing well and can reason about what happens when parts of it fail.

  • Strong Go, or deep production experience in another statically typed backend language (Java, Kotlin, Rust, C#) and the appetite to be shipping Go within your first weeks.

  • PostgreSQL in depth: schema design, query plans, locking and isolation levels, migrations on live systems, and multi-tenant data.

  • End-to-end ownership in the cloud. Working knowledge of AWS or GCP: IAM, networking, managed databases, queues and storage. You can read and change Terraform and debug production from traces and logs.

  • AI-native engineering. You use coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and can show how. You write the specs and context, break work down for them, and review their output as hard as a human pull request. You know where they fail.

  • Staff-level experience. A track record of delivering large, technically hard projects end to end and helping the engineers around you get better. Typically 8+ years building backend systems.

  • Clear, concise writing in a remote company that makes decisions in documents and async threads.

  • Security fundamentals for sensitive data: encryption in transit and at rest, key handling, minimising personal data, and least-privilege access.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Applied cryptography: encryption, signing and key management.

  • Decentralized identity: DIDs, verifiable credentials, DIDComm.

  • Regulated finance, payments or compliance: Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022.

  • Building and running software under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls.

  • Crypto and blockchain knowledge: chains, addresses, assets, CAIP identifiers.

  • Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Queue and workflow systems, and modern observability tooling.

Benefits

  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere!

  • $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment.

  • MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs.

  • Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need.

  • Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you’re returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Technical Manager to lead our Platform Services Mobile Foundations engineering initiatives in Portugal! This is a Remote – Portugal position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal. In this role, you will lead a multidisciplinary software engineering team focused on building core frontend and mobile platform foundations, SDKs, and integration services (including push notifications, identity, and localization) across the entire Wellhub ecosystem. As a Technical Manager , you will bridge hands-on technical architecture with people leadership and project management. You will directly manage a team of engineers, drive technical execution, align product roadmaps with system architecture, and mentor team members in career growth. While your primary focus will be people, execution, and strategy, your strong technical background, specifically with React and React Native ecosystems, will allow you to guide architectural discussions, perform code/design reviews, and maintain delivery quality. YOUR IMPACT Technical Project Management: Drive end-to-end delivery of complex cross-functional platform initiatives, aligning frontend/mobile requirements with Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) and core services. Technical & Architectural Leadership: Act as a technical soundboard and leader for mobile/frontend architecture (React / React Native), ensuring scalable, robust design patterns and sound technical trade-offs. Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration: Serve as a key liaison between Product, UX, and consumer teams (e.g., CODE / Wellhub App team) to negotiate technical scope, roadmaps, and integration standards. Culture & Engineering Excellence: Establish best practices for testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and developer experience across platform frontend services. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE You have proven experience managing and leading engineering teams (people management, hiring, performance management, career development). You possess a solid software engineering background with hands-on experience in React and React Native ecosystems, as well as modern frontend/mobile architecture. You have a track record of leading technical projects from conception to deployment, balancing engineering quality with time-to-market. You understand distributed system architecture, including modern mobile architectures, Micro Frontends, BFF (Node.js), RESTful APIs, and GraphQL. You demonstrate strong organizational and project management capabilities (roadmap execution, sprint planning, risk mitigation, resource allocation). You possess strong communication skills, capable of bridging technical details with non-technical stakeholders in both Portuguese and English. You foster an inclusive, collaborative culture and enjoy mentoring developers to help them reach their full potential. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in React / React Native & Mobile architecture are mandatory requirements WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. HEALTHCARE: Health insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Wellhub was named one of the Best Engineering Teams and Top IT Companies to Work For in Portugal! Join a team where technology, purpose, and wellbeing come together. Read more about our award here. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. #LI-REMOTE #LI-BG1
